Body.Content:
Turn ideas and source material into rich, interactive reports and dashboards with Pages. Start with a prompt and bring together content, visuals, charts, and interactive elements in one shareable Page where you can work with your collaborators and agents. Edit content on the Page directly just like any other Microsoft 365 file.

GA date: December CY2026

Preview date: November CY2026
